# Security Policy

**Please do not disclose security-related issues publicly.**

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest stable release of this package on Packagist.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this package, please report it privately:

1. Prefer [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/blendbyte/laravel-paypal/security/advisories/new).
2. Or email [security@blendbyte.com](mailto:security@blendbyte.com).

Include enough detail to reproduce the issue (affected versions, a description of the impact, and a proof of concept if you have one). Do not open a public issue or discussion for security reports.

We will acknowledge reports as soon as we can and address confirmed vulnerabilities in a new release.
